SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
THURSDAY - AUGUST 4, 2022 - 05:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
* COVID-19 NOTICE *
To protect public health and safety during the COVID-19 pandemic and in compliance with the current State Department of Public Health and Los Angeles County Health Officer Orders and City of Cerritos COVID-19 Safety Plan, the City Council Chamber will be open to the public. As authorized by State of California Executive Orders N-25-20, N-29-20, and N-08-21, and subsequently by Assembly Bill 361 (Chapter 165, Statutes of 2021) and City Council Resolution No. 2022-10 adopted pursuant thereto, this meeting may also be conducted via teleconference, if necessary. Public observation and participation in this meeting will be facilitated through the methods described below.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Recreation Services Division, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Recreation Services Division during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to recreation@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1254 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in-person in the Council Chamber subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in-person at the meeting or by using the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to recreation@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Recreation Services Division no later than 12:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 12:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

Comments are limited to 5 minutes per person. Public comments on agenda items will be taken at the time the item is before the Commission for consideration.

8A.
Reports from the Cerritos Parks and Recreation Commissioners
During this part of the meeting, members of the Commission report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports required by AB 1234. In addition, consensus may be given to refer potential initiatives, policies, programs, or projects to the City Council, for City Council direction on whether to have the Commission review and advise on such initiative, policy, program, or project at a future Commission meeting. Pursuant to the provisions of the California Brown Act, there will be no discussion or action taken on any of the matters that may be presented during this agenda item.
9.
